command:
set -euo pipefail; EXPECTED=e5eef6b97bef9a1e7b0f3b3146e4a73dd86c166b; git fetch --quiet origin main; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"; test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$EXPECTED"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=normal)"; USBINFO=$(ioreg -p IOUSB -l -w 0); printf '%s\n' "$USBINFO" | grep -q '40:4C:CA:5D:0A:00'; PORT=$(python3 - <<'PY'
import glob,sys
ports=glob.glob('/dev/cu.usbmodem*')
if len(ports)!=1:
    print('Expected exactly one C6 usbmodem candidate, got: '+repr(ports), file=sys.stderr); sys.exit(2)
print(ports[0])
PY
); case "$PORT" in /dev/cu.usbmodem*) ;; *) exit 3;; esac; test "$PORT" != '/dev/cu.usbserial-1130'; echo "SONOFF_STABILITY_C6_PORT=$PORT"; PORT="$PORT" python3 - <<'PY' | tee /tmp/c6_sonoff_stability.log
import os,serial,time
port=os.environ['PORT']
s=serial.Serial(); s.port=port; s.baudrate=115200; s.timeout=0.20; s.write_timeout=1; s.dtr=False; s.rts=False; s.open()
start=time.monotonic(); end=start+650.0; sent=False
try:
    while time.monotonic()<end:
        elapsed=time.monotonic()-start
        if not sent and elapsed>=1.0:
            s.write(b'permit 180\n'); s.flush(); print('>>> SENT: permit 180', flush=True); sent=True
        data=s.readline()
        if data:
            print(data.decode('utf-8','replace').rstrip(), flush=True)
finally:
    s.close()
PY
LOG=/tmp/c6_sonoff_stability.log; echo '=== SONOFF STABILITY COUNTS ==='; printf 'announce=%s rejoin=%s leave_reset=%s descriptor=%s binding=%s reporting=%s temp=%s humidity=%s battery=%s security_failed=%s\n' "$(grep -c 'ZIGBEE_DEVICE_ANNOUNCE 881a14fffeef6bd9' "$LOG" || true)" "$(grep -c 'ZIGBEE_DEVICE_REJOIN 881a14fffeef6bd9' "$LOG" || true)" "$(grep -c 'ZIGBEE_DEVICE_LEAVE_RESET ieee=881a14fffeef6bd9' "$LOG" || true)" "$(grep -c 'descriptor 881a14fffeef6bd9' "$LOG" || true)" "$(grep -c 'binding 881a14fffeef6bd9' "$LOG" || true)" "$(grep -c 'reporting 881a14fffeef6bd9' "$LOG" || true)" "$(grep -c 'measurement zigbee/zigbee:881a14fffeef6bd9/ch1 temperature=' "$LOG" || true)" "$(grep -c 'measurement zigbee/zigbee:881a14fffeef6bd9/ch1 humidity=' "$LOG" || true)" "$(grep -c 'measurement zigbee/zigbee:881a14fffeef6bd9/ch1 battery' "$LOG" || true)" "$(grep -c 'security failed 0x13' "$LOG" || true)"; grep -E 'ZIGBEE_DEVICE_(ANNOUNCE|REJOIN|LEAVE)|basic 881a14fffeef6bd9|binding 881a14fffeef6bd9|reporting 881a14fffeef6bd9|measurement zigbee/zigbee:881a14fffeef6bd9|security failed 0x13' "$LOG" || true; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=normal)"
